name: metocean_profile
title: MetOcean Profile for OGC API - EDR
description: An EDR profile in support of providing access to meteorological datasets in the MetOcean community of practice, covering in-situ observations and Numerical Weather Prediction output. Profile of OGC API - EDR Part 1: Core.

collections.title: In-situ meteorological observations
collections.description: Real-time in-situ meteorological surface observations (air temperature, wind, humidity, pressure) from land stations.

custom.reference: Height of measurement above ground level in meters

air-temperature-2m-instantaneous.label: Air Temperature at 2m (instantaneous)
air-temperature-2m-instantaneous.description: Instantaneous air temperature at 2 metres above ground level

wind-speed-10m-mean.label: Wind Speed at 10m (10min mean)
wind-speed-10m-mean.description: Mean wind speed over 10 minutes at 10 metres above ground level

wind-from-direction-10m-mean.label: Wind Direction at 10m (10min mean)
wind-from-direction-10m-mean.description: Mean wind direction over 10 minutes at 10 metres above ground level

relative-humidity-2m-instantaneous.label: Relative Humidity at 2m (instantaneous)
relative-humidity-2m-instantaneous.description: Instantaneous relative humidity at 2 metres above ground level

air-pressure-at-sea-level-instantaneous.label: Air Pressure at Sea Level (instantaneous)
air-pressure-at-sea-level-instantaneous.description: Instantaneous air pressure reduced to mean sea level

observedProperty.label: Air Pressure at Mean Sea Level

metocean:level.description: Height above ground in metres; SHALL match a value in the level custom dimension

collections.title: Global deterministic NWP model forecast
collections.description: Global deterministic Numerical Weather Prediction output. Each model run is exposed as an EDR instance (/instances/{instanceId}) identified by an RFC3339 datestamp; a data query with no instance targets the latest run.

id.description: ECMWF short name from Annex D

description.description: Parameter name as listed in Annex D

requirements.statement: An API definition SHALL be described using an OpenAPI 3.1 document.
parts: The API definition SHALL be described using an OpenAPI document (version 3.1 or higher).
The OpenAPI document SHALL be encoded as one of the OpenAPI JSON/YAML media types.
The landing page SHALL link the OpenAPI document with rel=service-desc.
The landing page SHALL link API documentation with rel=service-doc and type text/html.

requirements.statement: A collection identifier SHALL NOT convey structured metadata and SHOULD use the fixed value list.
parts: A collection identifier SHALL NOT be used to convey structured metadata.
A collection identifier SHOULD use one of insitu-observations, climate_data, radar_observations, weather_warnings, weather_forecast.
The identifier string MAY include a postfix to the listed values if needed.

requirements.statement: A title SHALL be set for all collections and SHALL NOT exceed 50 characters.
parts: A title SHALL be set for all collections.
A title SHALL NOT have more than 50 characters.
A title SHOULD be written in English.
A title SHOULD place the most important information first to guard against truncation.
A title SHOULD describe the collection understandably for non-experts (topic/domain and geographical area).

requirements.statement: A collection SHALL link to a license of its data with rel=license and type=text/html.
parts: The links property in a collection SHALL contain a link to a license of its data.
The license link SHALL set the rel property to license.
The type property SHALL be set to text/html.
If the data is open data, the license SHALL be CC BY 4.0 with href https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/.

requirements.statement: The collection spatial extent and CRS list SHALL use OGC:CRS84.
parts: The value of extent.spatial.crs SHALL be OGC:CRS84.
The value of crs SHALL include the element OGC:CRS84.
If crs_details is specified for a data_queries object, it SHALL include an object whose crs value is OGC:CRS84.
Additional CRSs SHOULD be presented as EPSG:<code> in crs and data_queries.*.crs_details.crs.

requirements.statement: The value of extent.temporal.trs SHALL be Gregorian.
parts: The value of extent.temporal.trs SHALL be Gregorian.

requirements.statement: Parameter objects SHALL specify label, description and unit using the profile conventions.
parts: The keys in parameter_names and id in the parameter object SHALL NOT convey structured metadata.
A parameter object SHALL specify the fields label, description and unit.
label SHALL NOT have more than 50 characters.
label SHALL be written in English.
unit SHALL use QUDT; unit.symbol.type SHALL be https://qudt.org/vocab/unit/<unit> and unit.symbol.value the qudt symbol.
observedProperty SHALL use the CF-convention (observedProperty.id = https://vocab.nerc.ac.uk/standard_name/<name>) when available; otherwise use observedProperty.description.

requirements.statement: A radius data query within_units array SHALL contain m (SI unit of length).
parts: The within_units array in a variables object for a radius data query SHALL contain m.
within_units MAY contain more values, each defined as a unit at https://qudt.org using the unit symbol.
A radius query with a limit parameter SHOULD return the closest items to the radius centre.

requirements.statement: A /locations response SHALL be a GeoJSON FeatureCollection with id and properties.name per feature.
parts: The /locations response SHALL be a GeoJSON document with a FeatureCollection object.
Each Feature SHALL have id of type string and properties.name of type string.
If not all collection parameters are provided, properties.parameter-name SHALL list a subset of the parameter_names keys.
Links with more information SHALL be included in properties.links as OGC API - Common link objects.
A more detailed description MAY be provided via properties.description.
All strings SHALL be in English.

requirements.statement: Empty results SHALL return HTTP 204 and 4xx responses SHOULD comply with RFC 9457.
parts: A query for data inside the extent that results in no data SHALL return HTTP 204 with no content.
A query partially within the extent SHALL respond as within the extent, returning only the in-extent portion.
Any 4xx response SHOULD comply with RFC 9457 Problem Details for HTTP APIs.

requirements.statement: An insitu-observations collection SHALL support locations, area and radius.
parts: A collection SHALL support locations, area and radius.

requirements.statement: Insitu parameters SHALL specify metocean:standard_name, metocean:level and measurementType.
parts: Each parameter SHALL specify metocean:standard_name set to a value from the standard_name custom dimension.
Each parameter SHALL specify metocean:level set to a value from the level custom dimension.
Each parameter SHALL specify measurementType.

requirements.statement: An insitu-observations collection SHALL define standard_name and level custom dimensions.
parts: The collection SHALL have an extent.custom object with id standard_name.
Custom dimension standard_name SHALL list CF standard names in values.
Custom dimension standard_name SHALL specify reference https://vocab.nerc.ac.uk/standard_name/.
The collection SHALL have an extent.custom object with id level.
Custom dimension level SHALL specify reference "Height of measurement above ground level in meters".

requirements.statement: CoverageJSON parameters SHALL carry metocean:measurementType, metocean:standard_name and metocean:level.
parts: Each object in parameters in a coverage SHALL have metocean:measurementType with the same properties as measurementType.
Each object in parameters SHALL have metocean:standard_name.
Each object in parameters SHALL have metocean:level.

requirements.statement: NWP parameters SHALL use ECMWF short names per Annex D for id and description.
parts: WIPPS Manual Global Deterministic NWP parameters SHALL be provided using ECMWF short names per Annex D.
The parameter name SHALL be provided in the description property.
The ECMWF short name SHALL be provided in the id property.

requirements.statement: An NWP collection represents a model; instances represent model runs identified by RFC3339 datestamps.
parts: A collection SHALL represent and describe a model.
A collection instance SHALL represent and describe a model run.
A collection instance identifier SHALL be represented by an RFC3339 datestamp.
A collection temporal instance or interval SHALL represent a timestep or timesteps of a model run.

requirements.statement: An NWP collection SHALL support position and cube; no instance means latest.
parts: A collection SHALL support position and cube queries.
Data queries without an instance SHALL be interpreted as the latest instance of a collection.
A datetime parameter between two timestamps SHALL trigger an HTTP 400 Bad Request.

requirements.statement: All data queries SHALL support CoverageJSON as a response format.
parts: All data queries SHALL support CoverageJSON as a response format.

requirements.statement: CoverageJSON domain.referencing system id SHALL reflect the crs query parameter (default OGC:CRS84).
parts: With no crs query param, domain.referencing.* system SHALL have type GeographicCRS and id OGC:CRS84.
With a crs query param, the system object with type GeographicCRS SHALL set id to the crs query param value.

steps: Retrieve the API landing page.
Verify a link with rel=service-desc references an OpenAPI 3.1 document.
Verify a link with rel=service-doc has type text/html.
Retrieve /collections.
Verify each collection id matches the fixed value list (optionally with a postfix).
Retrieve /collections.
Verify each collection has a title of at most 50 characters.
Retrieve a collection.
Verify links contains a rel=license link with type text/html.
Retrieve a collection.
Verify extent.spatial.crs is OGC:CRS84 and crs includes OGC:CRS84.
Retrieve a collection.
Verify extent.temporal.trs equals Gregorian.
Retrieve a collection.
For each parameter verify label, description and unit are present.
Verify unit.symbol.type is a QUDT unit URI and observedProperty.id is a CF standard name URI when present.
Retrieve a collection that supports radius.
Verify the radius variables within_units array contains m.
Send a GET /locations query.
Verify the response is a GeoJSON FeatureCollection.
Verify each Feature has a string id and a string properties.name.
Send a query inside the extent that returns no data; verify HTTP 204 with no content.
Send a request that yields a 4xx; verify the body complies with RFC 9457 (application/problem+json).
Retrieve the insitu-observations collection.
Verify data_queries contains locations, area and radius.
Retrieve the insitu-observations collection.
Verify each parameter has metocean:standard_name, metocean:level and measurementType.
Retrieve the insitu-observations collection.
Verify extent.custom includes standard_name (with the nerc reference) and level.
Request insitu data as CoverageJSON.
Verify each parameters object has metocean:measurementType, metocean:standard_name and metocean:level.
Retrieve the NWP collection.
Verify parameter ids use ECMWF short names from Annex D and descriptions carry the parameter name.
Retrieve /collections/weather_forecast/instances.
Verify each instance id is an RFC3339 datestamp representing a model run.
Retrieve the NWP collection.
Verify data_queries contains position and cube.
Verify a datetime range request triggers HTTP 400.
For each data query, verify CoverageJSON is an offered response format.
Request data without a crs param; verify domain.referencing system id is OGC:CRS84.
Request data with a crs param; verify the system id matches the crs param.
